label: Diagram 4.5
caption: Diagram 4.5 Floor treatment 1 – wall treatment 1 | Floor treatment 2: platform floor with absorbent material
description: The drawing is a section, headed "Diagram 4.5 Floor treatment 1 – wall treatment 1" and marked "SECTION" at the lower right corner. On the left is a vertical wall drawn as a stack of rectangular blocks filled with diagonal hatching. To the right of the top of this wall, down to the upper floor, is a narrow vertical strip filled with a zigzag pattern. Two horizontal floor constructions project to the right from the wall. The upper one is a horizontal slab over a deep trussed section, with X-shaped diagonal bracing at each end. The lower construction is a similar horizontal slab that contains, across its depth, a row of overlapping curved loops, with X-braced truss members at the left and right ends. Beneath this lower slab, to the right of the wall, is a second narrow vertical strip, again filled with the zigzag pattern, mirroring the strip above.
